% Pattern: env/class. The class siamltex defines theorem, lemma, corollary,
% proposition and definition on one counter within the section, and the
% paper declares none of them. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want definition-1 definition 1.1
% want proposition-1 statement/proposition 1.2
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 2.1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
\documentclass[final]{siamltex}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{definition} A space is bounded when a ball holds it. \end{definition}
\begin{proposition} Every finite space is bounded. \end{proposition}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{proof} Take a finite cover by balls. \end{proof}
\end{document}
